name: Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power (568-774 A.D.)
description: This site is a chain of seven building groups scattered across Italy, from Cividale del Friuli in the northeast to Benevento in the south. Together they preserve the legacy of the Lombards, a Germanic people who arrived in 568 and ruled much of the peninsula until 774. Fortress remains, churches and monasteries show Roman, Byzantine and northern styles blending as Antiquity gave way to the Middle Ages.
